requested_outcome: Turn every privacy-safe real search into a manageable page opportunity and provide a premium, task-oriented administration command center for reviewing demand, editing complete SEO/GEO content, previewing, scheduling, publishing, auditing and sitemap inclusion.
natural_destination: The authenticated VII administration at /admin/search-pages and the corresponding public search page and sitemap on vii.spaplus.co.
authorization_boundary: Local implementation, tests, repository commit and previously authorized production publication are in scope. No paid service, infrastructure purchase, arbitrary script injection, supplier mutation or fabricated analytics is authorized.

lesson_bundle.reason: The old search-page workflow is the parity source.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Inventory and preserve capture, pending review, editing, publication, traffic evidence and sitemap behavior.

lesson_bundle.reason: The request is for a daily operating system, not a decorative dashboard.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require short task paths, persistence, audit history, preview, publication and natural-destination reflection.

lesson_bundle.reason: The core entity is normalized search intent and result quality.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Capture world, filters, results and zero-result state without personal free text and expose diagnostics.

lesson_bundle.reason: Published opportunities must become intentional indexable search pages.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require canonical, robots, metadata, sitemap state and measured demand before publication.

lesson_bundle.reason: Search content, SEO fields and lifecycle must be safely editable.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require validation, versions, scheduling, publication status and rollback path.

lesson_bundle.reason: Demand and conversion numbers must be real data contracts.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Define period, source, uniqueness, result count and intent-versus-outcome semantics.

lesson_bundle.reason: The system must be deep but immediately understandable.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Present one work queue, one selected opportunity and one dominant next action with progressive disclosure.

lesson_bundle.reason: The final result must be published and verified on the exact live destination.
lesson_bundle.acceptance_impact: Require saved version, rollback identity, live route checks and sitemap verification.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The screen looks better but searches still do not create real pending records.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Persist an idempotent opportunity for each normalized search event.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A new event creates one pending opportunity; replaying the same event does not increment it twice.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Only location is recorded and the event type shown in the supplied example is lost.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Normalize a bounded filter dictionary and stable intent key.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The example location plus event type appears as one distinct opportunity with its filters visible.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The editor only changes a title and description and is still a toy.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Add workflow, slug, H1, metadata, editorial body, FAQ, indexability, canonical, preview, history and publish controls.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: A manager can save, reload, preview and publish all required fields from one workspace.

predicted_rejections.rejection: Published content does not control the real public page or sitemap.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Resolve published content from the authoritative version and include only eligible published paths in sitemap generation.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: The public page reflects the version after reload and its canonical path appears in sitemap only when publishable.

predicted_rejections.rejection: The interface is dense, generic and still feels like ten percent of a real system.
predicted_rejections.prevention: Replace the flat navigation and table-like editor with a responsive command-center shell, prioritized queue and contextual inspector.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Desktop and 390px mobile show a clear current task, status, metrics and next action without hidden required capability.

predicted_rejections.prevention: Show only persisted search counts, unique sessions, zero-result counts and current result inventory with explicit period and source.
predicted_rejections.acceptance_check: Displayed figures reconcile with database queries and missing data is shown as unavailable, not zero.

vacation, spa and hourly search tracking compatibility
D1 search events and page opportunities
content queue and search analytics entry points
public event search landing metadata and content
desktop, 390px mobile and low-height administration layouts
Hebrew typography, loading, empty, validation, conflict and service-failure states

sources.label: Old VII search-result page and requested workflow
VII management and search acceptance standard

midpoint_gate.trigger: The first end-to-end slice can ingest the supplied search shape and return it as a pending opportunity in the admin API.
checks: event and filter normalization is privacy-safe
pending opportunity includes demand, result count and proposed public path

attack_questions: Can a search combination with a type and location disappear or merge into the wrong opportunity?
Can a draft or archived page leak into the sitemap or public metadata?
Can a save claim success without surviving reload and adding an audit version?
Does the 390px layout hide the queue, primary action or validation state?
Can replay, conflict, expired session or database failure produce a false success?
adversarial_close.natural_destination_evidence: Authenticated live admin flow plus the exact published public page and live sitemap response.
adversarial_close.affected_family_evidence: Automated contracts, build, desktop/mobile browser interaction matrix and live regression of existing search and admin routes.

effectiveness.baseline: Current admin has separate basic screens; content queue only matches existing location pages, search events omit full filter intent, and the editor exposes title and description only.
effectiveness.target: One authenticated workspace exposes every recorded search opportunity and completes draft-to-public workflow with no missing required field or separate hidden screen.
